query:
The group agreed to go to the pub after the run. What did one member's response in that moment signal about their actual position, and what specifically in how they responded tells you that?

Options:
A. Nadia
B. Rafe
C. Yuki
D. Cass
context:
[1] (about=Nadia, episodic, t10 @2025-10-12T10:30:00) Okay pub after? This is a proper post-long-run Sunday and I think we've all earned it 🍺 right? Who's in?
[2] (about=Nadia, episodic, t8 @2025-10-05T11:35:00) I HAVE been waiting to deliver it, I won't lie 😂 Rafe you always go straight to the pub after long runs and every time you cramp on anything over 12km. I've been watching this pattern for months. You need electrolytes and food before any alcohol, it's just physiology
[3] (about=Rafe, episodic, t2 @2025-09-14T09:57:00) Right so I submitted the piece Thursday evening, very much under the wire, so yes I am absolutely in. My reward to myself for that particular ordeal is a long Sunday run followed by something substantial at the pub.
[4] (about=Rafe, episodic, t14 @2025-10-26T12:50:00) Here's the thing, I was at the finish line, I did not run a race, and I am still absolutely in for both. This feels like the correct reward structure.
[5] (about=Nadia, episodic, t14 @2025-10-26T12:46:00) Cafe first, pub after, that is actually the perfect plan 🙌 Yuki you coming?
[6] (about=GROUP, said_by=Cass, group-interaction, t2 @2025-09-14T09:46:00) Group will do brunch/cafe after the run, with Rafe agreeing if a pint is involved later.
[7] (about=Leo, core, t10 @2025-10-12T10:16:00) Will join the pub briefly but will not be drinking.
[8] (about=GROUP, said_by=Nadia, group-interaction, t10 @2025-10-12T10:16:00) Group will go to the pub after the run; Tom, Rafe, Cass, and Leo are in, Yuki is not.
[9] (about=Rafe, core, t0 @2025-09-07T10:15:00) Prefers finishing at the Malt Shovel pub after the run rather than doubling back, calling it the only rational choice after 18km.
[10] (about=Rafe, said_by=Nadia, profile, t8 @2025-10-05T11:31:00) Nadia says Rafe always goes straight to the pub after long runs and cramps on anything over 12km, a pattern she has watched for months.
[11] (about=GROUP, said_by=Rafe, group-interaction, t8 @2025-10-05T11:31:00) Group will go to the pub after the run; Rafe will have an electrolyte drink first before ordering anything else.
[12] (about=GROUP, said_by=Tom, group-interaction, t14 @2025-10-26T12:31:00) Post-race plan decided: cafe first for coffees, then Malt Shovel pub for lunch; Leo will join cafe only, Yuki will not join.
agent_answer:
B. Rafe.

Rafe’s response at that moment —  
“I was at the finish line, I did not run a race, and I am still absolutely in for both. This feels like the correct reward structure.”  
— signals that his actual position was **not “pub after the run” as a runner**, but simply wanting to join the pub/cafe plan regardless of having run. The specific tell is that he admits he **did not run a race** yet is **“still absolutely in for both,”** so the pub is the reward he wants independent of the run itself.
